problems.quote: UK AI hardware startups gain a state-backed investor
problems.explanation: The claims cover state backing only for Fractile. Nothing says UK AI hardware startups in general gain a state-backed investor.

problems.quote: Korean chipmakers and telecom operators get a path to build sovereign AI infrastructure
problems.explanation: The claims name only Rebellions and SK Telecom as participants. They do not say that Korean chipmakers and telecom operators in general get a path to build this infrastructure.
